crossRefs.note: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean…
The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert…
The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was…
Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in…
Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
In all things be showing yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, be showing integrity, seriousness…
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…
not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the apostles gathered around Jesus and brought Him news of all they had done and taught.
translations.kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
translations.asv: And the apostles gather themselves together unto Jesus; and they told him all things, whatsoever they had done, and whatsoever they had taught.
